weapons.name: Secret Detector
weapons.author: RequestReaver
weapons.description: Detects secrets, API keys, tokens and private keys exposed in requests and responses, and raises a finding for each one.
features: Scans every request and response passing through the proxy
Detects AWS, Google, Slack, GitHub and Stripe keys
Flags private key blocks and OAuth client secrets
Raises a finding per secret with redacted evidence

notes: Overview screenshot, feature list and general category.
Detects AWS, Google, Slack, GitHub and Stripe keys plus private key blocks.

weapons.name: Hello World!
weapons.author: RequestReaver
weapons.description: A minimal example Weapon that adds its own view to the sidebar. A starting point for building Weapons with their own window.
features: Adds its own view to the left sidebar
Renders in a sandboxed frame, isolated from the app
A starting point for building panel Weapons

notes: Overview screenshot, feature list and general category.
